description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order made under Sec. 2 of the Revenue Protection Act No. 19 of 1962 and be effective from 21.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters related to customs duties and revenue protection. It contains a formal order made by the Minister of Finance under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962, which involves altering import duty rates, modifying lists of concessions and exemptions under the Customs Ordinance, and establishing regulatory procedures for commodity classification and duty application. The content focuses on legal frameworks, statutory instruments, and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
